content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on the licence grant scope.

- **§ 2(a) (p0022):** the grant runs to Client only — no affiliates, no contractors acting on our behalf, and no notice mechanism to add them (the Exhibit A right in § 2(b)(ii) covers sites, not entities). That fails even the fallback position.
- **§ 15 (p0080):** consent-based assignment with a carve-out only for a "financially responsible affiliate" — no successor/M&A carve-out, so the fallback's transfer element also fails.
- Not walk-away: the licence is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion (it runs until termination under § 12, with § 13 auto-termination tied to defined uncured breaches). The subscription (non-perpetual) term is noted but not flagged.

Redline validated (ok:true) inserting affiliates/contractors into the grant and a mutual successor-transfer carve-out, with affiliate-on-written-notice offered as fallback.
